lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: EVERY DOOR IN THIS ENTIRE BUILDING JUST WELDED ITSELF SHUT [beat] WE ARE OFFICIALLY TRAPPED IN HERE LIKE LAB RATS NIX!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look at the security monitors [beat] the principal isn't just locking us in [beat] she’s purging all the digital student records right now!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Attention students [beat] your identities as citizens are being erased [beat] prepare for the new mandatory curriculum of the Academy.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Nix [beat] look at the windows [beat] those aren't regular security shutters [beat] they are heavy steel blast plates meant to block out the world!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Don't look so surprised son [beat] your mother and I designed this containment protocol specifically for your generation of digital rebels.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You’re my father [beat] not some high-tech warden [beat] how can you do this to your own family just for a corporate paycheck?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: It’s not about the money Nix [beat] it’s about perfect order [beat] we are turning this school into the ultimate conditioning facility.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix [beat] I managed to bypass the firewall for one minute [beat] there is a secret basement floor that doesn't exist on any school map.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I don't care about your family drama [beat] just let me out of this hallway before those gas vents in the ceiling fully open!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Get back to your designated holding zones immediately [beat] or the disciplinary bots will be authorized to use physical force on everyone.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The disciplinary bots [beat] wait [beat] Dad [beat] those aren't robots [beat] those are the missing seniors from last year's graduation!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: They aren't missing anymore Nix [beat] they are the first successful graduates of the project [beat] and now it is finally your turn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The school is a cage [beat] the teachers are guards [beat] and Nix's parents just pulled the trigger on the final phase of the files.
